name: recipe-scraper-1.0.0
description: Extract structured recipe data from any public recipe URL using Schema.org JSON-LD

tools.name: recipe_scrape
tools.description: Fetch and parse a recipe page URL, returning structured data: ingredients, instructions, nutrition, timing, servings, cuisine, tags. Works on AllRecipes, Serious Eats, NYT Cooking, Minimalist Baker, Budget Bytes, and most major recipe sites.

url.description: Full URL of the recipe page to scrape (must be http or https)
